Principal Component Analysis of wild *Costus allenii*, *C. villosissimus*, and
their hybrids, used in the manuscript to visualize recent hybridization
(Methods: *Population genetics of wild plants — Recent hybridization*).

The PCA is computed by PCAngsd from ANGSD genotype likelihoods (beagle file).
Beagle generation and PCAngsd are in [`pca/`](pca/). This document only reads the
resulting covariance matrix and plots PC1 vs PC2.

Other genome-wide analyses (Ancestry_HMM, ABBA-BABA, Dsuite, PIXY, and
introgression-vs-QTL comparisons) live in their own folders/scripts; see the
methods folders `02_population_genetics_wild/` and `04_introgression_vs_QTL/`.

### Load packages
```{r}
#| echo: false
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

### Paths
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 3,
                      fig.path = "ANGSD/PCAngsd_figs/")
# Set to the directory holding ANGSD/ output (adjust for your machine).
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = ".")
```

### PCA of *C. allenii*, *C. villosissimus*, and hybrids

PCAngsd run on the beagle genotype-likelihood file (selected sites, 0.05x
coverage cutoff), estimating independent allele frequencies:

`pcangsd.py -beagle selected_sites_0.05co_AVH.genolike.beagle.gz -o AHV_260209.PCAngsd`

```{r AHV_PCA}
# Covariance matrix + population/ID info from PCAngsd
AVH <- read.table("ANGSD/angsd_out/AHV_260209.pop.info")
cov <- as.matrix(read.table("ANGSD/angsd_out/PCAngsd/AHV_260209.PCAngsd.cov"))
e <- eigen(cov)

PC1 <- e$vectors[, 1]
PC2 <- e$vectors[, 2]
spp <- AVH[, 2]
ID  <- AVH[, 1]
PC12.AVH <- data.frame(PC1, PC2, ID, spp)

# remove one low-breadth individual that snuck in
PC12.AVH <- PC12.AVH[-46, ]

# proportion of variance explained by each PC
variance_explained <- e$values / sum(e$values)

# number of sites in the dataset
num_sites <- "47,820"

ggplot(PC12.AVH, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, fill = spp)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, pch = 21, colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("#CC79A7", "#56B4E9", "#FFD700"),
    name = "Species",
    labels = c(expression(italic("C. allenii")), "hybrid",
               expression(italic("C. villosissimus")))
  ) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.text.align = 0, legend.position = "top") +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(variance_explained[1], 4) * 100, "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(variance_explained[2], 3) * 100, "%)")
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = -0.17, y = 0.21, label = paste("# sites =", num_sites),
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = -1.5, size = 4, color = "black")

ggsave("ANGSD/PCAngsd_figs/AHV_PCA_260209.png",
       device = "png", width = 10, height = 7, units = "cm", dpi = 600)
```
